name: category
description: FR-BB21 (roadmap section 2.1) -- ports the categories table from c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\BilimBaga\backend\migrations\008_categories_tags.up.sql. name is :localized_text with locales ["kk","ru","en"] and search_strategy "plain", queried: true, required: true -- the source column is a bare TEXT, but the category tree is user-facing in a trilingual product and the platform now supports per-locale generated columns (REQ-301), so this is a deliberate upgrade over the source rather than a plain transcription. track is :string, queried: true, not required -- the source column is a nullable TEXT with no CHECK; roadmap 2.1 names three built-in tracks (security, safety, loyalty) but since the source enforces no vocabulary, track stays :string rather than being promoted to :enum with a hard-coded vocabulary the source does not enforce. sort_order is :integer, queried: true, required: true, ported directly. No constraints -- the source declares no UNIQUE on categories. No id, created_at, updated_at or created_by field is declared: the record subsystem (Letflow.Entities.Records) mints record identity and the event store carries the audit timeline, so declaring these here would duplicate platform-owned state inside tenant content. parent_id is :string, queried: true, not required, holding the parent category's record_id (null = root of the category tree; ports the source's categories.parent_id UUID REFERENCES categories(id)). The foreign_keys entry fk_category_parent_id promotes it to a nullable uuid self-referencing column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (decision 0025; inert on the soft-delete path, where the live rule is Letflow.Modules.Exam.AuthoringRules category_has_children). The database does not prevent cycles (as with decision 0050); the authoring write rule refuses a re-parent that would form one (parent_cycle) and a parent that does not exist (parent_not_found). Indexes: idx_category_track over track and idx_category_parent_id over parent_id.
